font.reason: Geometric sans is the closest to the original Futura/Century Gothic mood; variable font so the real 500 (typing/pill/body) and 700 (title) weights exist.

comps.translatedSummary: Typing '#موسیقی' with an always-on red cursor, 1-frame hard cut to a wide grey pill with note icon, hold, glide/shrink to the tag slot, 1-frame hard cut to the cream note page titled «گروه‌های محبوب من» with three Persian body lines.

rtlDecisions.why: Persian text starts at the right; the cursor sits at the end of text, i.e. on its left (marginInlineStart). Typing uses typeOn prefix slicing so letters re-join; 7 chars vs 6 but same seed/cadence, last char lands before MORPH=48.
Icon replaces '#', the first (right-most) char, so icon is on the right and the word on the left; paddingInlineStart.
Persian word is ~580px at the same size; icon+word overflowed 740 and the icon was squeezed to zero. Icon flexShrink:0, gap 50. Timing/easing unchanged.
Pill now lands on the right, its right edge aligned with the title's right edge (x=1760), same bezier, same frames 66-80 and scale 0.554.
Right anchored (right:160/152), RTL text; body re-written idiomatically in 3 balanced lines; line-height 1.5.

rtlDecisions.what: Hard cuts, hold, seeds, colours, vertical positions
rtlDecisions.why: Rhythm skeleton (two cuts, one glide) is the core of the design.
All letterSpacing set to 0 to keep Persian joining.

concerns: Registry duration is 40 frames but the design is 132; verified with --duration 132 (not changed in source).
Pill word sits slightly off-centre (larger end padding) because the box was widened for fit.
